The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1943–1944''' was contested by 52 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Volewijckers|De Volewijckers]] won this year's championship by beating [[VUC (football club)|VUC]], [[LONGA (football club)|LONGA]], [[sc Heerenveen]] and [[Heracles Almelo|Heracles]].
